attributions.title: Vedaris original worked explanations
attributions.notes: New explanations by Codex, checked against official papers and keys. Reviews are AI-assisted; no human editorial review or IIT endorsement is claimed.

coverageNotes: The playable bank currently covers the listed complete papers from 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025, 2026. It is not a forty-year playable question bank.
The wider historical archive contains source links; those linked years are not counted as playable questions or complete solved mocks.
Original section rules, discrete answer alternatives and official numerical ranges are retained. Dropped questions receive their official full marks even when unanswered.
Explanations and chapter assignments were authored and checked by Codex; they are not official IIT worked solutions or a claim of human editorial review.
